test_title: PYST 23: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the underlined part of the sentence:

She sings __as better as__ a trained vocalist.
solution:
The correct answer is '**as well as**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The construction **"as...as"** is used to show that two things are equal in some way.
 
• In this structure, we must use the **positive degree** of the adjective or adverb (e.g., "well," not "better").
 
• Since the word modifies the verb **"sings,"** the adverb **"well"** is the grammatically correct choice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"She sings **as well as**__ a trained vocalist."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "as good as"** is often used colloquially, but "good" is an adjective. "Well" is the adverbial form needed to describe the action of singing.
 
• **Option 3: "so better than"** is a fragmented construction that does not follow standard English comparison rules.
 
• **Option 4: "as better than"** incorrectly combines the equality structure ("as") with the comparative structure ("better than").
